title: Starlink Access for Ukraine Remains Limited Despite Trump's Restoration Claims
detail: Officials say Starlink satellite service access for Ukraine remains limited, despite claims by President Trump that the service had been restored. Details are from the Guardian live blog summary.

media.caption: Starlink access for Ukraine remains limited, officials say

title: Reported Local Humanitarian Ceasefire in Oleshky
detail: A feed item reports that Russia and Ukraine agreed a local humanitarian ceasefire in the devastated city of Oleshky, reportedly brokered by Melania Trump. Only an aggregator link was available; the originating outlet could not be identified and no official confirmation was found, so this is unverified.
confidenceReason: Single aggregator link; no primary or Tier 1-2 corroboration found.

title: Russia and Ukraine Agree to Melania Trump-Brokered Localised Humanitarian Ceasefire
detail: Al Jazeera reports Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a localised humanitarian ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump. A Ukrainian negotiator says it starts Tuesday. Scope, location and terms were not detailed in the feed summary; this corroborates the earlier unverified Oleshky ceasefire report.

media.caption: Russia, Ukraine agree to Melania Trump-brokered localised ceasefire
